g.text: Input changes and outcome gaps answer different questions
NATURAL OULAD ONLY; post-result correction. Points pair monitoring distances with separate labelled audits for matching groups. Only jointly supported
subgroup accuracy-gap points are drawn; the CSV keeps all 108 group-feature-metric-model opportunities and their support statuses. Overlapping groups
are dependent. No regression, correlation test, causal claim, harm threshold, or drift-detection accuracy is inferred from this small cohort
